title: Factory preset XML assets with fixed masterSeed (Tight Metal Quad, Wide Double, Loose Garage Double, Subtle Thickener, Live Quad Tracking)
description:
Create the five factory APVTS XML preset assets under Resources/Presets/ only. These are BinaryData inputs for e.2 and regression fixtures per Build Spec §12. Each preset MUST include a fixed masterSeed so save/recall and regression are bit-identical (D2).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §12 (factory bank values) and §5 (stable parameter IDs/ranges/defaults)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h (voiceCount, timingSpread, pitchSpread, humanRate, tightness, monoXover, mix, panV1..panV4, width, latencyMode, outTrim, bypass; masterSeed as non-param state property)
- Source/StateManager.* and PluginProcessor get/setStateInformation XML/ValueTree shape (parameterLayoutVersion / masterSeed property names)
- Sibling ShredWidth factory preset XML under ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width/Resources/Presets/ for APVTS ValueTree XML conventions

Implement five files (exact names for BinaryData/CMake later):
1. Resources/Presets/TightMetalQuad.xml — voiceCount=4 (V4), timingSpread=4, pitchSpread=4, humanRate=40, tightness=75, monoXover=200, panV1=100, panV2=-100 (or 100/100 left/right pair per StateManager pan sign convention — prefer pan defaults style V1 left / V2 right if pans are bipolar −100..+100: panV1=-100, panV2=100, panV3=-60, panV4=60 if the phase goals "Pan 100/100/60/60" mean magnitude; fix magnitudes to 100/100/60/60), Mix=60, width=100, latencyMode=Studio, outTrim=0, bypass=0. Fixed masterSeed (document chosen uint64 constant in a comment, e.g. 0x544D5154deadbeef style unique per preset).
2. Resources/Presets/WideDouble.xml — V2, timingSpread=6, pitchSpread=5, humanRate=50, tightness=50, monoXover=180, pans hard L/R (100/100 magnitudes), Mix=50, Studio. Distinct fixed masterSeed.
3. Resources/Presets/LooseGarageDouble.xml — V2, timingSpread=12, pitchSpread=8, humanRate=70, tightness=20, monoXover=150, Mix=55, Studio. Distinct fixed masterSeed.
4. Resources/Presets/SubtleThickener.xml — V2, timingSpread=3, pitchSpread=3, humanRate=30, tightness=80, monoXover=250, Mix=35, Studio. Distinct fixed masterSeed.
5. Resources/Presets/LiveQuadTracking.xml — latencyMode=Live, V4, timingSpread=5, pitchSpread=4, humanRate=45, tightness=65, monoXover=200 (or default 180 if unspecified), Mix=50. Distinct fixed masterSeed.

XML requirements:
- Valid well-formed XML loadable as a juce::ValueTree / APVTS state fragment consistent with StateManager restore.
- Parameter IDs must match ParameterIDs.h strings exactly.
- Include layout/schema version property matching parameterLayoutVersion = 1.
- masterSeed MUST be present as a state/value-tree property (not an APVTS automatable param) with a fixed uint64 per file for regression.
- Choice params (voiceCount, latencyMode) encoded as index or choice text consistently with existing APVTS.
- Deterministic content; no host-specific absolute paths.
- Do not embed BinaryData or edit CMakeLists (e.2 sole owner).

Wave 1 independent of e.3–e.5.
acceptance_criteria: Resources/Presets/TightMetalQuad.xml exists with voiceCount V4, timingSpread=4, pitchSpread=4, humanRate=40, tightness=75, monoXover=200, Mix=60, and a fixed masterSeed property
Resources/Presets/WideDouble.xml exists with V2, timingSpread=6, pitchSpread=5, humanRate=50, tightness=50, monoXover=180, Mix=50, and a fixed masterSeed
Resources/Presets/LooseGarageDouble.xml exists with V2, timingSpread=12, pitchSpread=8, humanRate=70, tightness=20, monoXover=150, Mix=55, and a fixed masterSeed
Resources/Presets/SubtleThickener.xml exists with V2, timingSpread=3, pitchSpread=3, humanRate=30, tightness=80, monoXover=250, Mix=35, and a fixed masterSeed
Resources/Presets/LiveQuadTracking.xml exists with latencyMode=Live, V4, timingSpread=5, pitchSpread=4, humanRate=45, tightness=65, Mix=50, and a fixed masterSeed
Each preset XML is well-formed, uses ParameterIDs.h string IDs, includes parameterLayoutVersion=1, and embeds a distinct fixed masterSeed
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add juce_add_binary_data or BinaryData generation here (e.2)

allowed: APVTS/ValueTree XML shape matching StateManager restore
encode choice params as index or choice text consistent with existing APVTS
bipolar pan signs matching ParameterIDs defaults while magnitudes match §12
optional display-name property on the tree
choose unique documented uint64 masterSeed constants per preset
forbidden: add extra preset files beyond the five named assets
make masterSeed an automatable APVTS parameter
